description: One ETF's profile plus its latest daily row: close, shares outstanding, unit NAV, premium/discount, estimated net creation. ⚠️ Two premium fields, not interchangeable: `premium_rate_same_day` only when the NAV date equals the trade date; `premium_rate_ref` falls back to the latest NAV (date in `premium_ref_nav_date`) — cross-border ETFs publish NAV late, so `ref` is not same-day. Both are ratios (0.012 = 1.2%), not percentage points. ⚠️ `accum_nav` is not on the same basis as `unit_nav` after a share conversion — do not compare or derive returns. `quality` / `inputs_mask` say which inputs were present; `latest` null = no row yet.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

name: etf_show
